Early Years

With our internationally recognized curriculum for every age group, our tailored approach to learning means we will help you unlock your child’s learning…

Read more +

With our internationally recognized curriculum for every age group, our tailored approach to learning means we will help you unlock your child’s learning potential every step of the way.

A combination of two renowned curricula gives our youngest learners the best possible start. Our British Early Years Foundation Stage (EYFS) curriculum sets the standard for the learning, development, and care of Nursery and Reception children. This program is complemented by the International Primary Curriculum (IPC), which personalizes learning through a variety of thematic topics.

03

Primary

With our internationally recognized curriculum for every age group, our tailored approach to learning means we'll help you unlock your child’s learning…

Read more +

With our internationally recognized curriculum for every age group, our tailored approach to learning means we'll help you unlock your child’s learning potential every step of the way.

Our Primary School program integrates the best components of the National Curriculum for England and the International Primary Curriculum (IPC). Working towards clear Subject, Personal, and International learning goals, our Year 1-6 students expand their breadth and depth of knowledge, and immerse themselves in inspiring creative and thematic projects.

04

MIDDLE SCHOOL

With our internationally recognized curriculum for every age group, our tailored approach to learning means we'll help you unlock your child’s learning…

Read more +

With our internationally recognized curriculum for every age group, our tailored approach to learning means we'll help you unlock your child’s learning potential every step of the way.

Our broad and balanced Middle School curriculum nurtures our learners’ cognitive, physical, and emotional development. A wide range of subjects and learning experiences enable our students to identify their strengths and pursue passions, while also building their independence, confidence, and sense of social responsibility. This prepares them for the challenge of High School.

05

HIGH SCHOOL

With our internationally recognized curriculum for every age group, our tailored approach to learning means we'll help you unlock your child’s learning…

Read more +

With our internationally recognized curriculum for every age group, our tailored approach to learning means we'll help you unlock your child’s learning potential every step of the way.

Our globally respected two-year IGCSE program is consistent, challenging, and engaging. As well as deepening our students’ academic knowledge in their core and elective subjects, our curriculum nurtures the development of vital communication, research, and social skills. Guided by our specialist teachers, each student is supported to be ambitious, push themselves, and fulfil their potential.

Highly regarded around the world, the IBDP is the perfect springboard to the very best colleges and universities. Our students specialize in six subject areas and immerse themselves in the IB core program, which features an Extended Essay, Creativity, Activity, Service (CAS) activities, and the Theory of Knowledge. Challenging and rewarding, the IBDP develops well-rounded and successful global learners.

A TYPICAL DAY AT SOUTH LOOP

Each class will be taught by a lead teacher and a learning assistant.

Read more +

Each class will be taught by a lead teacher and a learning assistant. Your child will also have subject specialists for French, Spanish, Art, Dance, Music, and PE.

Circle time to discuss the day ahead.

early Morning

Academic and specialist lessons, plus outdoor break and snack time.

Morning

Students sit down lunch for family style meals which are pre-pared in-house and delivered to the classroom. Part-time Nursery students have the option to leave prior to or after lunch.

12pm

Students will continue in specialists classes including French, Spanish, Dance, Drama, PE, and Music.

Afternoon

Dismissal or After-School Clubs.

Late afternoon

11

A TYPICAL DAY AT SOUTH LOOP

In addition to their classroom teacher, students have subject specialists for French, Spanish, Art, Dance, Music, Science, and PE.

Read more +

In addition to their classroom teacher, students have subject specialists for French, Spanish, Art, Dance, Music, Science, and PE. Students are introduced to exciting and unfamiliar subjects, study citizenship and learn new skills in Masterclass. As they progress through school, learning support eases off, promoting independence and preparing students for Middle School.

Lessons begin.

early morning

Throughout the day, students will learn core skills in English and Phonics followed by break and snack.

Morning

The morning learning, which can include Math, concludes at midday when the students enjoy a nutritious meal in our cafeteria. Afterwards, they have time to play outside on the turf field with their friends.

Lunchtime

Every week, students will have specialist classes including French, Spanish, Dance, PE and Music.

Afternoon

Children are picked up, or may stay on to participate in a variety of after-school clubs.

Later afternoon

12

A TYPICAL DAY AT SOUTH LOOP

As students mature, BISC - South Loop begins a more intricate approach to education, ensuring children are intellectually energized and socially sophisticated.

Read more +

As students mature, BISC - South Loop begins a more intricate approach to education, ensuring children are intellectually energized and socially sophisticated. The curriculum plunges greater depths of complexity, opening students’ eyes to the wider theoretical applications of their skills and knowledge.

Students begin their day in their Advisory groups and then lessons begin.

Early Morning

Students move independently around the Middle School to different classes, including English, Math, and Science. They spend their 25-minute morning recess outside enjoying the use of our turf field, after which they participate in lessons including Design Engineering and Modern Foreign Language.

Morning

Students eat a freshly cooked meal with their friends in the cafeteria.

Lunchtime

Students will have specialist classes including Dance, Drama PE and Music.

Afternoon

Lessons end, but students may participate in fun after-school extracurricular activities and sports, or receive academic or homework support from their teachers.

Late afternoon

13

A TYPICAL DAY AT SOUTH LOOP

Students commence their higher studies with both eyes on their desired university.

Read more +

Students commence their higher studies with both eyes on their desired university. With enthusiastic support from their teachers and encouragement to pursue independent study, our high school students invariably leave South Loop with the path ahead well and truly forged.

Students begin their day in their Advisory groups and then lessons begin.

8:25am

Students focus on core learning skills English and Math. After break, High School students will focus on elective courses

Morning

Students enjoy a hearty meal in our cafeteria, or may leave campus with their friends if they wish.

Lunchtime

Students will continue learning from specialists in each of their lessons.

Afternoon

Lessons end, but students may stay on to elicit help from their teachers or unwind with some sports or extracurricular activities.
